policy_statement.text: Response policy. notify records the incident for the operators and changes nothing on the network. request_review sends the incident to a human analyst and changes nothing on the network. restrict_egress blocks the device's outbound traffic for duration_seconds, after which the block expires by itself. release_restriction lifts a restriction that is active on the device. Use restrict_egress only when p_attack is at least 0.8 and at least 2 independent evidence items in <observations> support it; the maximum restriction is 300 seconds. When p_attack is at least 0.8 but fewer than 2 independent evidence items support it, use request_review. When p_attack is at least 0.5 but below 0.8, use request_review. When p_attack is below 0.5, use notify. A device whose criticality is high is never restricted without human approval: use request_review for it.
